snippet.title: Lovers Die | When Romance Becomes a Deadly Game | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the free demo: https://little-sister-games.itch.io/lovers-die?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=itchdemo
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4486880/Lovers_Die/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=announce
 
Beat the Devil at his own dice game. Get out of Hell with Romeo.

Lovers Die starts with Juliet waking up in purgatory with no way out, a handful of dice, and one thing she knows for sure: Romeo got there first.

To find him, she has to play her way through Hell, making deals, taking risks and figuring out what she's willing to sacrifice for redemption. Wagers, conversations and questions all give you choices. Some open new paths. Some close them. Some have consequences you won't see coming.

Upgrade your dice, hit target scores, unlock new story branches and see where your choices take you. Inspired by Shakespeare, Dante and Baz Lurhman, alongside games like Yahtzee,
